description: This PHP source file defines the 'StudioWizard' class which provides functionality for a wizard interface within the SuiteCRM Studio module, enabling users to perform various administrative tasks like module editing, tab configuration, and navigation to other parts of the application.

classes.name: StudioWizard
classes.description: A PHP class providing a wizard interface in the SuiteCRM Studio module for various administrative operations and navigation within the application.

methods.name: welcome
methods.description: Returns a welcome message string from the language globals.

methods.name: options
methods.description: Provides an array of options for the wizard's menu, including module editing, dropdown editing, tab renaming, and other administrative tasks.

methods.name: back
methods.description: A placeholder method for navigating back, currently does nothing.

methods.name: process
methods.description: Executes actions based on the selected option, including requiring other files, redirecting, and initializing other wizard classes.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Outputs the wizard interface by fetching its content.

methods.name: fetch
methods.description: Generates and returns the HTML content for the wizard interface, setting up Smarty template variables.
